title: Cross-repository suite manifest v1
description: suite.yaml: tasks of the eval tree whose base is a commit of another repository (docs/repo-evaluation-contract.md §2.1). `repos` names the scaffold repositories, each referenced as <url>@<rev> (a local pinned path works too); `tasks` lists the tasks of the eval tree that take their base checkout from one of them. This is an input the benchmark repository owns, so it carries `schema`, not `schema_version`. Semantic rules (every task is a task of the tree, every repo name is declared, revisions are full commits unless the run allows floating ones) are checked in dokimi/repos/suite.py, which says them in friendlier words.
